Name: (CB) Aggressive Curses Of The Valley
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Now I thought the Statue of Blessings was lacking... But instead of making it better, what if it made your life even worse? Because... why not I guess. Who [i]doesn't[/i] like to struggle. 

Using the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25267]Custom Blessings Framework[/url] I added 5 pretty intensive curses to the game to make life atrocious. Because investing all of those items into the statue just to be cursed is very 'fun.'

These ones are also some opposites to pair with my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25301]Blessings[/url] mod - but these felt a bit intensive and "annoying" in comparison to the other curses, so I made it into it's own mod. I could have done an optional file, but I felt like it might add a bit of confusion.


Spoiler for the curses:

[spoiler]
Curse Of Harming: -10 Max Health
Curse Of Lifesteal: -1 Health Per Second
Curse Of Exhaustion: -1 Stamina Per Second
Curse Of Lethargy: -0.5 Health Per Second, -0.5 Stamina Per Second
Curse Of Peril: -25 Max Stamina, -1 Defense, -1 Immunity, -5 Max Health, -0.5 Health Per Second, -0.5 Stamina Per Second [/spoiler]

Notes: If you want regular curses or a bunch of new blessings, try out:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25341]My Curses Mod[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25301]My Blessings Mod[/url]

I suggest doing both of them at minimum since just having the curses will remove any blessings from the game, even the vanilla ones. But, if you want a challenge, have fun!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
